title: Writing Task 1 - Process: Water Cycle
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe a diagram showing the natural water cycle.

stimuli.title: Task 1: The Natural Water Cycle
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The diagram below illustrates the natural water cycle, showing how water moves through the environment.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Stages: Solar energy heats ocean/lake surfaces causing evaporation → Water vapour rises and cools, forming clouds (condensation) → Precipitation falls as rain or snow → Surface runoff flows to rivers → Groundwater percolation feeds underground aquifers → Rivers and groundwater return to oceans → Cycle repeats. Transpiration from plants also contributes water vapour.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the diagram illustrating the natural water cycle and its key stages.

keyFeatures: The cycle is driven by solar energy, which initiates evaporation from water bodies
Condensation and precipitation are the key mechanisms for transferring water to land
Water returns to the ocean via two parallel pathways: surface runoff and groundwater
Plant transpiration is an additional input that contributes to cloud formation
